thread:
taylor: quick follow-up from today's AH about runway and the new spend rules. a few practical questions from my squad: exact approval bands, any p-card cap changes, and what's the unblock flow if a customer-facing demo is blocked. cc @camille @raul

camille (CFO): short answer: runway is ~15 months under current plan; we've tightened discretionary spend and added a "fastlane" for verified customer-impact incidents. below are the details.

taylor: can you spell out the approval bands so I can update my team doc?

camille (CFO): effective now: < $2,000 = manager approval only; $2,000 	6 $20,000 = procurement + finance required; $20,000 	6 $200,000 = senior finance sign-off + procurement; > $200,000 = CFO + legal + procurement and enterprise onboarding mandatory. these are narrower than before to cut low-value spend.

mira: new p-card numbers?

camille (CFO): default p-card single-transaction cap = $2,000; rolling monthly = $10,000. p-cards cannot be used to pay onboarding/setup fees for new vendors > $2,000. exceptions via Spend Request need two approvers and a rationale.

raul (procurement): onboarding SLA update: standard vendors = 5 business days, elevated-risk = 12 business days. we also maintain a vetted infra vendor list to speed buys. incomplete packets will pause approvals, so please attach everything in one go.

mira: demo incident: last week we had to buy extra GPU time mid-demo. what's the fastest path?

camille (CFO): use the Spend Request, mark tag="fastlane", include customer impact + demo time window, and ping @raul + @ops-bot. procurement can issue a temporary PO or authorize a p-card exception up to $20k for verified customer-impact incidents while onboarding finishes. CFO sign required for > $20k, but we aim for a same-day unblock for demos when possible.

ops-bot: ops contingency fund available up to $8k for urgent infra unblocks. DM ops-bot with 1-2 sentence justification and expected procurement completion ETA.

olivia (legal): quick legal note: any agreement with data access, SLAs, or indemnity goes to legal regardless of dollar amount. attach the contract intake when you submit.

raul (procurement): i'll host a 30-min procurement office hour tomorrow 3pm for folks with pending requests. add to the calendar or drop Qs here.

taylor: perfect 	6 thanks everyone, will share with the team :thumbsup:
